author: David Leisering
title: Mitch Keller done in by longball on Tuesday
desc: Mitch Keller allowed three runs on seven hits with one walk and four strikeouts over six innings on Tuesday in Pittsburgh's 3-2 loss to the Mariners.
impact: All three runs off of Keller came courtesy of a pair of Seattle home runs - a solo shot by Cal Raleigh in the fourth and a two-run blast by Cole Young in the sixth. After allowing just one home run in his first six starts of the year, Keller has now surrendered eight over his last nine outings, including at least one in each of his last four starts. The righthander has pitched to a 6.75 ERA in four June starts and is 5-5 with a 4.89 ERA in 16 appearances this season. Keller is lined up to face the Reds in a home matchup on Sunday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Robert Suarez dealing with forearm soreness
desc: Robert Suarez was unavailable for Tuesday's game against the San Diego Padres due to forearm soreness.
impact: Atlanta Braves manager Walt Weiss described Suarez's forearm injury as something that gradually crept up on him over the course of the season. Suarez is scheduled to play catch on Wednesday to gauge how he feels and determine next steps.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Sean Murphy (finger) may not return until August
desc: Atlanta Braves manager Walt Weiss said Sean Murphy will likely be sidelined through the end of July.
impact: Less than two weeks after returning from the injured list, Murphy was placed back on the IL with a fractured left finger, suffered on May 10 during a catcher's interference play. He has appeared in just four games this season, going 1-for-14 with six strikeouts.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Brant Hurter (spine) begins throwing progression
desc: Brant Hurter began a throwing progression on Monday.
impact: Hurter has been on the injured list since May 24 due to lumbar spine inflammation. He has begun a throwing progression but does not yet have a clear timetable for return.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Mike Trout (hamstring) completes light on-field work Tuesday
desc: Mike Trout completed light on-field exercises on Tuesday.
impact: Trout sustained a right hamstring strain on June 17 and has since progressed to light on-field work. While no official timeline for return has been provided, he indicated at the time of the injury that he was already feeling better and optimistic about a relatively short stint on the injured list, which offers some reason for cautious optimism for fantasy managers.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Adam Frazier (elbow) to begin throwing program Wednesday
desc: Adam Frazier is scheduled to start a throwing program on Wednesday.
impact: Frazier has been sidelined since June 6 with right elbow inflammation. He has been hitting on the field, taking grounders and running without issue, and is now set to begin a throwing program. Fantasy managers can expect him to return at some point in July.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Junior Caminero drives in three runs in loss Tuesday
desc: Junior Caminero went 3-for-5 with a home run, one run scored and three RBI in Tuesday's 12-5 loss to the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Caminero snapped an 0-for-8 skid with three strikeouts over his previous two games by delivering a three-hit performance on Tuesday. He continues to enjoy an outstanding season, posting an .862 OPS that ranks second among qualified third basemen.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Chandler Simpson swipes bag Tuesday
desc: Chandler Simpson went 0-for-2 with two walks, one run scored and a stolen base in Tuesday's 12-5 loss to the Kansas City Royals.
impact: Simpson has continued to showcase his speed, recording a stolen base in three of his last four games. Although he has struggled in June with a .170/.228/.189 slash line across 53 at-bats, he appears to be turning the corner after reaching base safely in five consecutive games.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Shane McClanahan gives up three homers Tuesday
desc: Shane McClanahan allowed six runs (two earned) on six hits and one walk while striking out four over six innings in Tuesday's 12-5 loss to the Kansas City Royals.
impact: McClanahan surrendered two home runs to Jac Caglianone and one to Nick Loftin, but was able to overcome that and complete six innings for the first time this season. He has endured a difficult June, posting a 5.79 ERA and 1.82 WHIP across 18.2 innings. McClanahan will look to bounce back in his next scheduled start on Sunday against the Arizona Diamondbacks.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Shohei Ohtani will be in lineup while on mound Wednesday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said Shohei Ohtani will hit during his pitching start on Wednesday.
impact: Ohtani will both hit and pitch per usual against the Twins on Wednesday.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Joe Mack powers Tuesday win with homer
desc: Joe Mack went 2-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and two RBI in Tuesday's 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Mack hit a 395-foot home run to right-center field off Jose Corniel in the fourth inning. After posting a disappointing .203/.250/.250 slash line in May, he has turned things around in June, slashing .327/.397/.596.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Owen Caissie logs homer Tuesday
desc: Owen Caissie went 1-for-4 with a home run, one run scored and three RBI in Tuesday's 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Caissie has recorded a hit in five of his last six games, totaling three home runs, six runs scored and seven RBI during that stretch. While he is batting just .191 in June, he has still produced a solid .489 slugging percentage thanks to two doubles and four home runs on the month.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Heriberto Hernandez goes deep Tuesday
desc: Heriberto Hernandez went 2-for-3 with one home run, a double, a walk, two runs scored and an RBI in Tuesday's 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Hernandez bounced back from an 0-for-4 performance in the series opener with a big game on Tuesday, collecting six total bases, including a 416-foot home run off Cal Quantrill in the second inning. Hernandez has enjoyed a strong June, slashing .293/.339/.655 with six home runs. He is worth considering in deeper fantasy leagues while he continues to receive consistent at-bats.

author: Nicholas Rodriguez
title: Sandy Alcantara picks up win Tuesday
desc: Sandy Alcantara allowed one run on five hits and three walks with four strikeouts across 6.2 innings in Tuesday's 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers.
impact: Alcantara allowed six batters to reach base over the first two innings but limited the damage to one run. He then settled in, surrendering just one hit and one walk the rest of the way. Alcantara has enjoyed an outstanding June, recording a quality start in all five outings while posting a 2.60 ERA and 1.04 WHIP with 29 strikeouts across 34.2 innings. He is lined up to make his next start on Monday against the Colorado Rockies at Coors Field.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Samad Taylor collects three hits Tuesday
desc: Samad Taylor went 3-for-4 in the Padres 7-6 win over the Braves on Tuesday.
impact: Taylor continued his strong stretch since joining the Padres at the start of June. He collected his third three hit performance in just 15 games with San Diego, now hitting .370 overall at the plate for the Padres.
